messages.author: claude
messages.text: Sketched dispatch end to end: Drivers stream Location into an in-memory Supply index, Dispatch ranks nearby Candidates by ETA and sends a time-boxed Offer, and the Trip aggregate (one live Offer, one Match per Driver, CAS on version) runs Requested → Offering → Matched → OnTrip. The fork worth discussing: greedy sequential Offers per Trip vs. batching Trips every ~2s for a better global Match.
